purpose: Persistent machine-readable mechanics cache for live BPB decision support.

Just Stats.effect: Start of battle: Gain 12% maximum health and 10% base stamina regeneration.

Enchanted Weapons.effect: Attack effects of Weapons have a 25% chance to repeat. Every 5.2s: Gain 1 of the buff you have least of.
Enchanted Weapons.notes: Current 2026-07 community reference confirms 25%. Applies to weapon attack/hit/miss effects, not effects granted to the weapon by another item such as a socketed gem.
Enchanted Weapons.source: backpackbattles.wiki.gg Skill page + wikiwiki.jp/bpb current page

Uniquely Unique.effect: The item triggers 20% faster +10% for each Unique item, Customer Card or Platinum Customer Card. Chance to find Treasure items +65%. You can obtain +2 Treasure items.

Inner Power.effect: Start of battle: Gain 2 Vampirism and 1 Empower. Relevant tagged items heal 2% more per Vampirism and trigger 2% faster per Vampirism, up to 100%.

Unidentified Skill.effect: On buy: Replace this with a random other Skill from your pool.

Shielded.effect: Shields have +30% chance to block. Armors trigger 60% faster.

Smithing For Dummies.effect: On buy: Generate a Whetstone. Start of battle: Crafted Weapons gain 1 damage and use -40% stamina.

Seal the Deal.effect: Shop refreshes: 30% chance for a Trade offer. Trade value +1 gold. Every 5.2s: Use 2 Regeneration to gain 3 Vampirism; use 2 Luck to gain 3 Spikes; use 2 Mana to gain 2 Empower.

Broom.effect: Opponent misses attack: Gain +2 damage for the next attack. On hit: 33% chance to inflict 1 Blind.

Whetstone.effect: Start of battle: starred Weapons gain 1 damage.

Spear.effect: On hit: Destroy 4 Block for each free starred slot.

dual_weapon_into_shields.observation: Dual-weapon architectures can suffer disproportionately into shield and especially double-shield opponents because repeated attack attempts consume stamina while blocked attacks convert poorly into damage.
dual_weapon_into_shields.scope: session strategic observation; treat as matchup hypothesis/prior, not universal deterministic mechanic
